definition.title: Sequence-mode cross-codec concatenation [report paragraph label]
definition.source_excerpt: R127 goes farther: H.264/fMP4 → VP9/WebM. sequence mode keeps the independent second clip adjacent without setting timestampOffset; the result is a contiguous 4 s red→green presentation.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
